analysis.rationale: R1 independent re-verification: pipeline blur_lens:4 -> compression_jpeg:4 -> saturate_weaken_HSV:5 reproduces every one of the k=3 support targets bit-exactly (PSNR=inf, CI 10/10) and peeled_noise_check residual std=0.0. PSNR=inf is the global optimum, so no CHANGE can improve the fit; exactness simultaneously pins function types, severities and the order (saturate applied after JPEG storage). R0 support PSNR 21.32 is therefore attributable to training/inverse-problem difficulty (0.46M Direct Swin, EPOCH=2, 1.42 GPU-h, severe lens:4 blur is ill-posed), not to a blind-ID mismatch. R1 signal reinterpretation found no evidence against the R0 pipeline: block_boundary=3.983 (Tier S, 0% FP) + dct_zero_ratio=0.913 -> JPEG; gm_ratio=0.426 + spectral_slope_ratio=1.245 -> blur; saturation_chroma_ratio=0.0 -> saturate_weaken:5; variance_ratio=0.910 with contrast_spread_ratio=1.004 and brightness_from_jpeg=True (brightness FP, brighten_shift:1 tested 19.23 dB in R0) rule out contrast/brightness; noise_prior sigma=1.11 < 2 and zero peeled residual -> NO_NOISE. The FFT anisotropy=3.95 motion hint is a false positive (blur_motion:4 chain scored 18.95 dB in R0 vs bit-exact lens chain).
